patches.applies: clean, zero rejected hunks, against the f5185e38 sources

patches.subject: log hit, miss, miss-invalid, store and no-store on stderr when BEND_CGEN_CACHE_LOG is set; silent and output-neutral otherwise

measured.note: The candidate emits the base release's C byte for byte, on the hit path and with the cache off.

probes.byte_bound: FAIL: MAX_BYTES is evaluated only inside trim(), and store() calls trim() only when entries exceed MAX_ENTRIES, so below 33 entries the byte bound never acts

known_issues.issue: MAX_BYTES is not an independent bound.
known_issues.detail: cache.ts store() calls trim() only when readdirSync(dir).length > MAX_ENTRIES; trim() is where MAX_BYTES is tested. With 32 or fewer entries the cache can exceed 256 MiB; the largest observed artifact on this host is the coordinator's 53,448,597-byte C, so 32 of those is about 1.7 GiB.
known_issues.proposed_fix: Call trim() after every store instead of only past the entry bound. Proven on a probe copy: with MAX_BYTES lowered to 250000, six stores trimmed to two entries and 184090 bytes, the evicted entry recomputed the same C, and the surviving entry still hit.
known_issues.not_applied: This release carries cache.patch unmodified, so it ships the bound as upstream wrote it.
